sentence: 25-year-old woman, smoker of about 10 cigarettes/day, with no other history of interest.
She was admitted with symptoms of > 5 diarrheal stools, sometimes accompanied by blood and weight loss.
A colonoscopy was performed, observing a normal colonic mucosa.
In the terminal ileum, three ulcerations with irregular contours are seen, with a fibrinous background.
Biopsies are taken, which confirm the diagnosis of Crohn's disease.
Analytically, she has an albumin of 2,890 mg/dl with no other findings.
She was referred to the Nutrition consultation, not observing protein catabolism, reduction in intake or other causes of malnutrition.
A1AT is performed in blood: 159 mg/dl; A1AT in feces: 1.28 mg/g; stool weight in 24 hours: 182.84 g.
A1AT clearance was 147.19 ml/day (> 56 ml/day), confirming the diagnosis of PLE.
After treatment with azathioprine and high protein nutritional supplements, the patient improved clinically, with serum albumin rising to 3,270 mg/dl.
